documentation.role: Native frame, pixel registration and product definitions; consulted during site ingestion.

realization_convention.method: Use the published cloned surface directly. The _err.tif files contain the original DEM plus a spatially correlated error realization (Figure 11 panel G), not just panel F error offsets.
realization_convention.reference: Barker et al. 2021, DOI 10.1016/j.pss.2020.105119; Figure 11 and Section 4
realization_convention.selection: Published 0001, 0002 and 0003 per site; not selected on any simulation outcome.
limits: Three predeclared surfaces per site are a bounded sensitivity subset, not the complete 100-clone ensemble or a calibrated failure probability.
All surfaces share the nominal analysis origin and frame. Regional PGDA90 terrain remains nominal.
LOLA count masks describe nominal-cell return support; a return in a 5 m cell does not establish wheel-scale hazards or exact height throughout that cell.

connecting-ridge.encoding: RGB8 PNG, filter 0, zlib level 9; north-to-south native row order
connecting-ridge.registration: One image pixel per native nominal LDEC cell. Map via source south-polar stereographic coordinates; nearest filtering, no mipmaps.
connecting-ridge.limit: A nominal-cell return-support display, not a terrain safety or wheel-scale coverage map.

shackleton-rim.encoding: RGB8 PNG, filter 0, zlib level 9; north-to-south native row order
shackleton-rim.registration: One image pixel per native nominal LDEC cell. Map via source south-polar stereographic coordinates; nearest filtering, no mipmaps.
shackleton-rim.limit: A nominal-cell return-support display, not a terrain safety or wheel-scale coverage map.

limits: Declared rover response and rigid friction are not calibrated lunar mobility.
5 m posting does not establish wheel-scale clearance.
Thermal screening is optional: declared uniform battery/enclosure properties and a constant assumed ground boundary, not calibrated hardware or an instantaneous lunar-temperature forecast.
Numerical horizon convergence and observed-shadow validation remain pending.

physics_input_grid.source: PGDA78-Site01 surface height, transformed to local ENU metres
physics_input_grid.mesh_spacing_m: 2 × half_extent / 80; 0.5 m on a 40 m patch
physics_input_grid.gazebo_mesh: Collada 1.4.1; metre units; Z_UP; 12800 upward-facing triangles
physics_input_grid.identity: SHA-256 of canonical packet and conditioned terrain; each packet retains the source manifest
physics_input_grid.limits: Interpolation adds no measured detail. Analytical flat-drive/free-fall fixtures are explicitly synthetic and carry no NASA source manifest.
physics_input_grid.normals: Normalized (-dh/dEast, -dh/dNorth, 1) from finite differences on the conditioned grid, explicitly indexed per vertex in Collada for DART; not added measured detail

thermal_model.active_temperature_dataset: Diviner PCP historical context (two southern-summer local-time bins), used only when explicitly selected as a constant boundary scenario.
thermal_model.forcing: Pinned SPICE solar direction/distance and terrain visibility; no convection.
thermal_model.properties: Explicit mission inputs retained with each run; defaults are hypothetical.
thermal_model.limits: One uniform node, constant ground boundary (declared or copied from historical Diviner context), fixed electrical capacity/voltage, threshold charging inhibition; no hardware calibration or instantaneous lunar temperature forecast.

diviner.title: LRO Diviner polar cumulative bolometric brightness temperature composites

citation.title: Seasonal Polar Temperatures on the Moon

diviner.quantity: Average bolometric brightness temperature from compiled nadir observations

coordinates.projection: south polar stereographic; x/y normalized by lunar mean radius 1737400 m
coordinates.label_note: PDS4 labels attach deg to normalized x/y despite the normalized-coordinate description. Clavius uses explicit center latitude/longitude and checks x/y × 1737400 against an independent stereographic conversion.
coordinates.registration_limit: No external image-to-LOLA registration or absolute positional accuracy validation; 240 m posting is not guaranteed accuracy.

limits: Historical summer/local-time composites, not instantaneous temperatures for a requested mission epoch.
Bolometric brightness is not in-situ soil or robot battery temperature.
Only two local-time bins are loaded; neither a complete diurnal curve nor minimum/maximum temperatures.
Missing observations remain gaps; no temporal interpolation or distant nearest-neighbor filling.
Per-bin measurement counts and temperature error bars are not supplied in these tables.
Cell lookups conservatively reject a 2 m border near the nominal 240 m cell edge.
Copying a value into the thermal model declares a constant boundary for the entire mission; it does not validate that boundary in time or space.

derivative.method: Preserve covered native records inside a 5 km stereographic square around Connecting Ridge, retaining original one-based table row IDs; no raster interpolation.
Preserve covered native records inside a 5 km stereographic square around Shackleton rim, retaining original one-based table row IDs; no raster interpolation.

origin_selection.method: Existing curated Connecting Ridge reference point; approximate navigation origin, not a surveyed landing location.
Published Site04_ROIs.dbf record 4 X/Y attributes, converted from source south polar stereographic metres.
origin_selection.limit: A curated analysis origin inside the published ROI, not proof of landing or rover safety.

observed_shadow_validation.purpose: Validation only: two regional scene dates, one overlapping epoch at the curated 5 m sites; not active rover-site imagery.
